narrative.overview: The latest user-approved direction restores Marmoset’s gold, red and cream palette while retaining the modern Composio-inspired layout and bundled Geist. Gold headers, red actions and links, cream supporting surfaces and warm neutrals keep dense academic content easy to scan. The first viewport gives the course table room to breathe and keeps every desktop project column visible.
keyCharacteristics: Gold headers, red actions and links, cream support surfaces and warm neutrals.
Locally bundled Geist and tabular numbers.
Wide desktop tables and labelled phone project fields.
Flat surfaces and reversible enhancements to original workflows.

rules.name: Outcome integrity
rules.body: Preserve outcome text and recognized states; never infer grades or submission success.

rules.name: Quiet depth
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and fine borders without shadows or unnecessary motion.

dos: Do use the user-approved upstream gold/red/cream palette, bundled Geist and shared light/dark roles.
Do keep all five desktop project columns visible and phone fields labelled.
Do retain original links, forms, navigation and textual outcomes.
Do provide visible keyboard focus, overflow cues and honest empty states.
donts: Don't claim the upstream palette is a verified match for the deployed Waterloo stylesheet.
Don't infer grades or submission success, or add misleading date sorting.
Don't add decorative nested cards, pill actions, shadows or unnecessary motion.
Don't claim signed-in live verification from fixture tests.
